suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Rock with high-energy J-Rock influences. Distorted electric guitars play driving power chords and palm-muted eighth notes. A prominent synth lead plays a bright, sawtooth-based melody. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a consistent eighth-note pulse. Drums feature a heavy snare on 2 and 4 with rapid hi-hat patterns and frequent crash cymbal accents. Male vocals are delivered with a powerful, melodic belt in the tenor range, featuring slight grit during the chorus. The arrangement uses sudden stops and dramatic builds. Key of E Major, 165 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, driving drums, bright synth melody]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted guitar, bass pulse]
빨간 불이 켜져 있잖아요
대본대로 가고 있었거든요
[guitar opens up]
웃으면서 한마디를 던졌어
대본에 없는 말이었어

[Pre-Chorus]
[bass slides, building drum fill]
나가면 안 되는 말이었거든요
대처할 틈도 없었어요

[Chorus]
[full band, high-energy distorted guitars, crash cymbals]
[powerful tenor vocals]
스튜디오가 멈춰 섰어 (PD는)
